abstract: In a study of 20 patients diagnosed with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors between 1961 and 1993, clinical and pathologic findings were evaluated. Of the 20 patients, seven (35%) had dysgerminoma, two (10%) endodermal sinus tumor, three (15%) malignant teratoma, one (5%) malignant struma ovarii, one (5%) primary ovarian carcinoid, two (10%) benign teratoma with malignant transformation, and four (20%) combination germ cell tumor. Twelve patients (60%) had stage IA, five (25%) stage IC, and three (15%) stage IIIC. Twelve patients (60%) underwent conservative surgery and eight (40%) had at least bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. At follow-up, 18 patients (90%) were alive free of disease, one (5%) had died of disease, and one (5%) had died of intercurrent disease. The actuarial 5-year survival rate was 93.3%. It is concluded that for young women who wish to preserve child-bearing capacity, regardless of the stage of the tumor, fertility-preserving surgery with complete surgical staging followed, if necessary by cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy is an appropriate and definitive treatment in the absence of involvement of the contralateral ovary and uterus. For patients in whom child-bearing capacity is not an issue, surgery should include total abdominal hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy with complete staging, followed if necessary by chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 1961年から1993年の間に悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と診断された20例について、臨床および病理所見を評価した。20例の内訳は、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）7例（35%）、卵黄嚢腫瘍2例（10%）、悪性奇形腫3例（15%）、悪性卵巣甲状腺腫1例（5%）、原発性卵巣カルチノイド1例（5%）、良性奇形腫からの悪性転化2例（10%）、混合型胚細胞腫瘍4例（20%）であった。12例（60%）が病期IA、5例（25%）が病期IC、3例（15%）が病期IIICであった。12例（60%）は保存的手術を受け、8例（40%）は少なくとも両側卵管卵巣摘出術を受けた。フォローアップ時点で、18例（90%）が無病生存中、1例（5%）が原病死、1例（5%）が他病死であった。5年実測生存率は93.3%であった。対側卵巣と子宮への浸潤がない限り、病期にかかわらず、妊孕性温存を希望する女性には、完全な外科的病期分類を伴う妊孕性温存手術とし、必要に応じてシスプラチンを基にした併用化学療法を行うことが、適切かつ根治的な治療であると結論づけた。妊孕性が問題とならない患者では、完全な病期分類を伴い、総腹式子宮全摘出術と両側卵管卵巣摘出術を含む手術を行い、必要に応じて化学療法を行うべきである。
